q is undefined (X in simulation) until the first clock edge; hardware powers up to an arbitrary value.
Data enters at the LSB and shifts toward the MSB (q <= {q[2:0], data}), so the first bit received ends up in the MSB after four shifts.
Data enters at the MSB and shifts toward the LSB (q <= {data, q[3:1]}), so the first bit received is placed in the MSB and moves to the LSB after four shifts.
The 4-bit value decrements modulo 16, so 4'b0000 decrements to 4'b1111.
The counter saturates at 0, so 4'b0000 remains 4'b0000 when count_ena is asserted.
q[3] is the most significant bit and q[0] is the least significant bit (standard [3:0] vector declaration).
